test_title: Add a new todo item
preconditions: Application is loaded | Todo list is empty
test_steps:
1. Click the input field with placeholder 'What needs to be done?'
2. Type 'Buy groceries'
3. Press Enter
expected_result: A todo item with the label 'Buy groceries' appears in the todo list

test_title: Submitting an empty input does not add a todo
preconditions: Application is loaded
test_steps:
1. Click the new-todo input field without typing anything
2. Press Enter
expected_result: No new todo item is added to the list

test_title: Delete a todo item using the destroy button
preconditions: Application is loaded | At least one todo item exists
test_steps:
1. Hover over a todo item to reveal the destroy button
2. Click the destroy button
expected_result: The todo item is removed from the list and no longer appears

test_title: Footer is hidden when no todos exist
preconditions: Application is loaded | Exactly one todo item exists
test_steps:
1. Hover over the single todo item to reveal the destroy button
2. Click the destroy button
expected_result: The todo list is empty and the footer is no longer visible

test_title: Clear completed removes all completed todos
preconditions: Application is loaded | Two completed todos and one active todo exist | Clear completed button is visible
test_steps: 1. Click the 'Clear completed' button in the footer
expected_result: Both completed todos are removed from the list; the one active todo remains; the 'Clear completed' button is no longer visible

test_title: Clear completed fires immediately with no confirmation dialog
preconditions: App is loaded | Completed todo 'Call dentist' exists | Completed todo 'Read book' exists
test_steps:
1. Click the 'Clear completed' button
2. Observe whether any modal, dialog, or confirmation prompt appears
expected_result: Both 'Call dentist' and 'Read book' are removed from the list immediately upon click; no confirmation dialog, modal, or prompt of any kind is shown at any point during or after the click

test_title: Items-left count reflects only active (incomplete) todos
preconditions: Application is loaded | Three todos exist: 'Task A' (active), 'Task B' (active), 'Task C' (completed)
test_steps: 1. Observe the items-left counter in the footer
expected_result: The footer displays '2 items left', counting only the two active todos and excluding the completed one.

test_title: All filter is selected by default on initial page load
preconditions: App is freshly loaded with no prior interaction
test_steps:
1. Add one todo 'Task A' so that the footer becomes visible
2. Observe the state of the filter buttons
expected_result: The 'All' filter button is rendered in a selected/active visual state; 'Active' and 'Completed' filter buttons are unselected; all existing todos are shown in the list

test_title: Empty input does not create a todo
preconditions: App is loaded | Todo list is empty
test_steps:
1. Click the new-todo input field
2. Press Enter without typing any text
expected_result: No todo item is added to the list; the footer remains hidden; the new-todo input remains empty

test_title: Submitting empty or whitespace-only input does not create a todo
preconditions: Application is loaded | No todos exist
test_steps:
1. Click the '#new-todo' input field and press Enter without typing
2. Type three space characters into '#new-todo' and press Enter
expected_result: No todo item is added to the list after either attempt; the list remains empty and the footer remains hidden.

test_title: Items left count decrements when a todo is marked complete
preconditions: Application is loaded | Two active todo items exist | Footer shows '2 items left'
test_steps: 1. Click the checkbox on one active todo item
expected_result: The footer count changes to '1 item left'

test_title: Clear completed removes all completed todos and leaves active todos intact
preconditions: App is loaded | Active todo 'Buy groceries' exists | Completed todo 'Call dentist' exists
test_steps: 1. Click the 'Clear completed' button in the footer
expected_result: 'Call dentist' is removed from the list; 'Buy groceries' remains visible; the footer count still reads '1 item left'; the 'Clear completed' button is no longer visible

test_title: Filter by Active shows only non-completed todos
preconditions: App is loaded | Active todo 'Buy groceries' exists | Completed todo 'Call dentist' exists
test_steps: 1. Click the 'Active' filter button in the footer
expected_result: Only 'Buy groceries' is visible in the list; 'Call dentist' is not rendered; the 'Active' filter button appears in a selected/highlighted state

test_title: Filter Active shows only active todos
preconditions: Application is loaded | Two active todos and one completed todo exist
test_steps: 1. Click the 'Active' filter in the footer
expected_result: Only the two active (unchecked) todo items are shown; the completed item is hidden

test_title: Unchecking a completed todo restores it to active
preconditions: Application is loaded | Exactly one completed todo exists: 'Exercise'
test_steps: 1. Click the checked checkbox next to 'Exercise'
expected_result: The checkbox becomes unchecked; 'Exercise' loses its completed visual styling; the items-left count increases by 1; the 'Clear completed' button disappears because no completed todos remain.

test_title: Whitespace-only input does not create a todo
preconditions: App is loaded | Todo list is empty
test_steps:
1. Click the new-todo input field
2. Type four space characters
3. Press Enter
expected_result: No todo item is added to the list; the footer remains hidden; the new-todo input is empty or cleared

test_title: Todos and their completion state survive a browser page refresh
preconditions: Application is loaded | Two todos exist: 'Morning run' (active) and 'Meditate' (completed)
test_steps:
1. Reload the page using the browser refresh control or F5
2. Observe the todo list after the page finishes loading
expected_result: Both 'Morning run' (active/unchecked) and 'Meditate' (completed/checked with completed styling) are present with their original completion states intact after reload.

test_title: Clear completed button is hidden when no completed todos exist
preconditions: Application is loaded | At least one active todo exists | No completed todos exist
test_steps: 1. Observe the footer
expected_result: The 'Clear completed' button is not visible in the footer

test_title: Filter All shows every todo regardless of state
preconditions: Application is loaded | Active and completed todos exist | Completed filter is currently selected
test_steps: 1. Click the 'All' filter in the footer
expected_result: All todo items (both active and completed) are displayed in the list

test_title: Filter by Completed shows only completed todos
preconditions: App is loaded | Active todo 'Buy groceries' exists | Completed todo 'Call dentist' exists
test_steps: 1. Click the 'Completed' filter button in the footer
expected_result: Only 'Call dentist' is visible in the list; 'Buy groceries' is not rendered; the 'Completed' filter button appears in a selected/highlighted state

test_title: Destroy button is visible only on hover
preconditions: Application is loaded | At least one todo item exists
test_steps:
1. Observe the todo item without hovering over it
2. Move the mouse pointer over the todo item
expected_result: The destroy button is not visible before hovering and becomes visible when the mouse is over the todo item

test_title: Delete a todo via the destroy button on hover
preconditions: App is loaded | One active todo 'Buy groceries' exists
test_steps:
1. Hover the mouse cursor over the 'Buy groceries' list item
2. Click the destroy button (×) that appears
expected_result: 'Buy groceries' is removed from the list; the todo list is empty; the footer is no longer visible

test_title: All interactive controls are reachable and operable via keyboard alone
preconditions: Application is loaded | Two todos exist: one active, one completed
test_steps:
1. Focus the browser window without using a mouse
2. Press Tab repeatedly to move focus through: the '#new-todo' input, the todo checkboxes, and the footer filter buttons ('All', 'Active', 'Completed')
3. When a checkbox has focus, press Space to toggle it
4. When a filter button has focus, press Enter or Space to activate it
expected_result: Every interactive element receives a visible focus indicator in a logical top-to-bottom order; checkboxes toggle their state on Space; filter buttons change the active filter on Enter/Space; no interactive control is unreachable by keyboard.

test_title: Footer item count reflects only active todos, not total todos
preconditions: App is loaded
test_steps:
1. Add three todos: 'Task A', 'Task B', 'Task C'
2. Mark 'Task A' and 'Task B' as completed
expected_result: The footer count reads '1 item left', not '3 items left' or '2 items left'; the count corresponds exclusively to the one remaining active todo

test_title: Clear completed button is hidden when no completed todos exist
preconditions: App is loaded | Two active todos 'Task A' and 'Task B' exist | No completed todos exist
test_steps: 1. Observe the footer
expected_result: The 'Clear completed' button is not rendered or not visible in the footer; the item count and filter buttons are visible
